definitions.explanation: The number of votes a candidate or party receives in an election.

examples.japanese: {得票|とくひょう}{数|すう}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
{彼|かれ}は{最|もっと}も{多|おお}くの{得票|とくひょう}を{得|え}た。
{前回|ぜんかい}の{選挙|せんきょ}と{比|くら}べて{得票|とくひょう}{率|りつ}が{大|おお}きく{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: Compared to the last election, the vote share dropped significantly.

notes: Common compounds: {得票|とくひょう}{数|すう} (number of votes obtained), {得票|とくひょう}{率|りつ} (vote share/percentage). Used in election and political contexts. Compare with {投票|とうひょう} (the act of voting/casting a ballot) — {得票|とくひょう} focuses on the receiving side.
